name: Blizzard
display_fullname: Mission Maker Attacks Ice Blast Blizzard
display_help: The massive damage from the Blizzard can Slow the attack rate of all your opponents in a large area, reducing their chance to hit and possibly knocking them back. Activating this power leaves you drained of Endurance and unable to recover any Endurance for a while. Damage: Extreme(DoT), Recharge: Very Long
display_short_help: Ranged (Location AoE), Extreme DoT(Cold), Foe -To-hit, -SPD, -Recharge, Knockback, Self -Recovery
